name: moneylens
description: Turn financial emails and statements into a local spending report covering spending, money in and transfers.

interface.longDescription:
MoneyLens turns your financial emails, bank and card statements, and transaction alerts into a spending report. It keeps a local ledger, matches alerts against statements, and shows spending, money in, transfers and anything that needs review. Confirmed and provisional amounts stay separate, and gaps in your sources stay visible.

Requirements: a local agent session, Python 3.10 or later (your agent can install it), and an email MCP provider that can read the messages and attachments you select. Scheduled updates also need your agent's scheduling tools. Installing the plugin doesn't connect email or create a schedule. Tested with Codex on macOS and Linux using Gmail. Other agents and email providers haven't been verified.

Privacy: your ledger and report are saved on your device. PDF extraction, reconciliation, calculations and report generation run locally. Your AI host and email connector still process the email and statement content your agent reads, under their own policies and your account settings. Local storage doesn't mean all processing stays on your device.

Protected PDFs: setup looks for unlock instructions in the email and in issuer guidance first, and only asks you for what's missing. If needed, a local form collects the details outside the AI conversation and checks them against the PDF. Working unlock values are stored locally in plaintext files with owner-only permissions so updates can run unattended. The ledger and report rely on filesystem permissions, not app-level encryption.

Limits: MoneyLens only sees what's in your email. It doesn't connect to bank APIs, SMS or payment apps, and scanned PDFs may need extra handling. Check unresolved items and their sources before relying on a total. MoneyLens is a reporting tool, not financial, investment, tax or legal advice.
defaultPrompt: Set up MoneyLens and my daily spending report.
